Question: An aquarium has a rectangular base that measures \(100\) cm by \(40\) cm and has a height of \(50\) cm. The aquarium is filled with water to a depth of \(37\) cm. A rock with volume \(1000\text{ cm}^3\) is then placed in the aquarium and completely submerged. By how many centimeters does the water level rise?
